title: Project Administrator
description:
An exciting opportunity has arisen to join a well-established and reputable glass and glazing company as a Project Administrator. We are looking for an organised, customer-focused individual to support the day-to-day administration of customer projects, ensuring a smooth process from initial enquiry through to completion.

This is a varied and fast-paced role where you'll be the key link between customers, suppliers, and the internal team, providing excellent service and ensuring projects run efficiently.

Glass and glazing knowledge is essential for this role

Key Responsibilities
- Answer customer enquiries via telephone and welcome walk-in customers.
- Gather customer requirements and prepare accurate quotations.
- Process customer orders and ensure all project information is recorded correctly.
- Purchase stock and liaise with suppliers to support project requirements.
- Monitor the progress of customer orders and maintain accurate records.
- Keep customers informed throughout the order process, providing regular updates.
- Notify customers when orders are ready for collection or delivery.
- Liaise with colleagues and suppliers to ensure projects are completed on time.
- Provide administrative support to ensure the smooth running of multiple projects.
- Deliver a high standard of customer service while managing enquiries and resolving issues promptly.

What We're Looking For
- Previous administration or project administration experience is desirable.
- Excellent customer service and communication skills.
- Good IT skills and confidence using Microsoft Office and office-based systems.
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities.
- Excellent attention to detail and a proactive approach to problem-solving.
- Ability to work independently as well as part of a team.
- A full UK driving licence is essential.

What We Offer
- A permanent, full-time position based in Dudley.
- Monday to Friday working hours (8:00am 5:00pm).
- A friendly, supportive, and professional working environment.
- Opportunities for training, development, and career progression.
- Competitive salary based on experience.

title: Operations Coordinator
company: Pertemps Black Country Perms - Agency - Permanent
description:
We are seeking a highly organised and proactive Operations Coordinator to support the day-to-day operational activities of the business. The role will be responsible for coordinating sales administration, stock control, export documentation, logistics management, ERP system administration, and customer service activities to ensure smooth and efficient business operations. The successful candidate will work closely with internal departments, suppliers, warehouses, freight providers, and customers to maintain high service levels and operational excellence.
Key Responsibilities
- Coordinate daily operational activities to ensure efficient order processing and fulfilment.
- Process customer orders accurately and efficiently through ERP systems.
- Generate quotations, sales orders, invoices, credit notes, and other customer documentation.
- Monitor stock levels and maintain accurate inventory records within ERP systems.
- Track inventory movements, stock adjustments, and replenishment requirements.
- Liaise with warehouse teams to investigate stock discrepancies and implement corrective actions.
- Produce stock reports and forecasts to support planning and procurement activities.
- Monitor product shelf life and minimise risks associated with aged or obsolete stock.
- Support ERP system improvements, testing, and implementation projects.
- Prepare export documentation including commercial invoices, packing lists, certificates, and customs paperwork.
- Ensure compliance with export regulations, customs requirements, and international trading standards.
- Coordinate domestic and international shipments with freight forwarders, hauliers, and logistics partners.
- Track shipments and provide customers with delivery updates.
- Work closely with warehouse teams to ensure accurate and timely dispatch of goods.
- Deliver exceptional customer service by handling enquiries, complaints, and order-related issues.
- Build strong relationships with customers, suppliers, logistics providers, and internal stakeholders.
- Support with reporting and process improvements

Key Skills
- Previous experience in an Operations Coordinator, Sales Administrator, Customer Service, Logistics, Export, or Supply Chain role.
- Strong knowledge of stock control and inventory management processes.
- Experience using ERP systems for order processing and inventory management.
- Knowledge of export documentation and international shipping procedures.
- Excellent administrative and organisational skills.
- Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including reporting and data analysis.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

If you have a background in international operations, stock control, ERP systems, sales support, export or logistics coordination this could be the role for you.

title: Receptionist
description: We are looking to recruit a receptionist to join our reception team within the Sexual Health Service. A flexible approach to this role is essential to ensure the demands of the service are met. As part of the team you will be registering patients onto the clinic computer system whereby accuracy is essential. Working knowledge of all common computer applications including word is essential, as you will be required to carry out a wide range of transactions and associated data input. Specialist training will be given on 'in house' systems. You should have a good standard of general education and have attained qualifications in English & Mathematics e.g. GSCE or equivalent. You will also require a clear understanding of the concept of confidentiality of personal health information. The role will encompass dealing with patients, clinical and non-clinical staff by face to face and telephone; subsequently you will require excellent communications skills. A flexible approach to this role is essential to ensure the demands of the service are met. As part of the team you will be registering patients onto the Trust computer system whereby accuracy is essential.
